pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Polygonal regions of light-brown pigment with smooth pixel gradients at edges due to low image resolution. Individual shapes are predominantly sub-rectangular or sub-triangular with rounded vertices.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous cream-colored pathways separating the pigmented patches. Intersections predominantly consist of three-way and four-way nodes with relatively uniform pixel thickness across the visible flank.
